reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) confirms that melt-spinning produces an amorphous structure in this alloy, but it provides no data on internal stresses, laser annealing effects, short-range ordering, or thermal stability boundaries. The key premises about stress relaxation, diffusion suppression, and precise temperature control are entirely unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Melt-spun Cr16Mn16Fe16Co16Ni16P20 is amorphous with residual internal stresses
Ultrafast laser pulses can relieve internal stresses in amorphous alloys
Picosecond-scale heating promotes short-range ordering without atomic diffusion
Stress relaxation and short-range ordering increase thermal stability against crystallization
Transient temperature rise can be kept below ~30 K above the amorphous stability limit
